items.title: File Einspruch against cancellation of Kindergeld
items.quote: Einzulegen ist er innerhalb eines Monats seit der Bekanntgabe – schriftlich, elektronisch oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Fri 27.08.2027, sent by ordinary post by a German authority (Familienkasse applies tax-procedure delivery rules, § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO): deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting = Tue 31.08.2027. Under § 108 Abs. 1 AO / § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery is not counted, so the one-month Einspruch period (§ 70 Abs. 2 EStG, Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) starts 01.09.2027 and ends, per § 188 Abs. 3 BGB, on the day of the last month bearing the same number as the delivery day, i.e. Thu 30.09.2027. That day is a working day (no weekend/holiday shift needed under § 108 Abs. 3 AO).

warnings: The letter confirms no repayment is owed for August 2027 ('Eine Rückforderung ergibt sich nicht.') — this is informational, not an obligation requiring action by the recipient.
